---
title: "How to cite"
description: "Citations for the research tools, plausibility checks, soil classification keys, the Soil Colour Reader and the homeowner tools."
toc: true
---

If a tool helped your work, please cite the tool **and** the published methods it implements. The method references are listed with each tool; they credit the people whose science the tool is built on.

All tools are version 1.0. Persistent identifiers (DOIs) will be added here as they are minted; until then, cite the web address.

## Check a result {#checks}

- Flynn, T. (2026). *Check a result: plausibility checks for soil and environmental results*, version 1.0 [software]. [checks.html](checks.html)

Each check also lists the method it is based on; please cite that as well.

## Soil classification keys {#soil-keys}

- Flynn, T. (2026). *WRB 2022 soil key*, version 1.0 [software]. [soil-keys.html#wrb](soil-keys.html#wrb)
- Flynn, T., Rasaei, Z. (2026). *WRB 2022 soil key, Farsi edition*, version 1.0 [software]. [soil-keys.html#wrb-fa](soil-keys.html#wrb-fa)
- Flynn, T. (2026). *WRB 2022 soil key, Kiswahili edition*, version 1.0 [software]. [soil-keys.html#wrb-sw](soil-keys.html#wrb-sw)
- Flynn, T. (2026). *South African soil classification key (2018)*, version 1.0 [software]. [soil-keys.html#sa](soil-keys.html#sa)

Please also cite the classification itself: IUSS Working Group WRB (2022), *World Reference Base for Soil Resources*, 4th edition, International Union of Soil Sciences, Vienna; or Soil Classification Working Group (2018), *Soil Classification: A Natural and Anthropogenic System for South Africa*, ARC-Institute for Soil, Climate and Water, Pretoria.

## Homeowner tools {#homeowners}

Some of the homeowner calculators (areas and volumes of irregular shapes, roof catchment, drainage) are also useful in research and fieldwork. Cite the collection:

- Flynn, T. (2026). *Homeowner tools: yard and garden calculators*, version 1.0 [software]. <https://rafikiardhi.earth/homeowners.html>
